{{Quote|Victorious we were at Christophsis, but defeated we have been at Selonia, Carida, and Garos Four. Another victory we do require.|Jedi Grand Master Yoda|<ref name="WS" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]<ref name="WS" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] won a victory over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the battle. The Republic's defeat at Carida, coupled with similar defeats elsewhere, led [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to believe that the Republic needed another victory in the war.<ref name="WS" /> However, later during the war, Carida was once again controlled by the Republic.<ref name="PoNR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DM:DS 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> the Republic held a [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|strategy conference]] aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Carida.<ref name="PoNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was briefly mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" />
